Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate Social Thanksgiving Rewards : Thank You for Being Here

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
We sincerely thank every streamer for their dedication, every creator for sharing valuable content, and every user for their continued support. This Thanksgiving, Gate Social is bringing you three special rewards. Watch livestreams, share your gratitude, and spread appreciation for a chance to win exciting prizes.
#### Event Period: November 26, 2026, 05:00 – December 2, 2026, 16:00 (UTC)
## Reward 1: Thanksgiving Live Comments | Engage More, Earn More
During the event, join the conversation in any Gate Live livestream. Post at least one valid comment related to gratitude or Thanksgiving to qualify for a share of the reward pool. The more valid comments you accumulate, the greater your share of the rewards.
## How to Participate:
- Watch any Gate Live livestream during the event and actively participate in the comments.
- Post at least one valid comment related to gratitude or Thanksgiving. For example: "Thank you for sharing market insights every day. Happy Thanksgiving."
- All valid comments made during the event will count toward your total, with no daily comment limit . The more valid comments you post, the higher your reward allocation.
- After the event, the reward pool will be distributed proportionally based on each eligible user's valid comment count relative to the total valid comments from all eligible users.
Event Rewards: All eligible participants will share a 500 USDT Thanksgiving Reward Pool . Additionally, 3 of the most heartfelt Thanksgiving comments will be selected, with each selected user receiving one piece of exclusive Gate merchandise.
## Event Rules:
- Participants must post at least one valid gratitude-related comment to qualify for the reward pool.
- One-click comments, quick replies, and other system-generated preset comments will not count as valid comments.
- Repetitive spam, meaningless comments, bot-generated comments, and other abnormal interactions will be excluded.
- Rewards will be distributed proportionally based on each user's cumulative valid comments relative to the total valid comments of all eligible participants. Final results are subject to platform verification.
## Reward 2: Thanksgiving Stories on Gate Square | Tag Someone You're Thankful For and Win Rewards
During the event, visit Gate Square and publish an original post with the hashtag #ThankfulForYou , tagging a Gate streamer or creator you would like to thank. Share your story and stand a chance to win Thanksgiving rewards.
- Visit Gate Square and publish an original post of at least 50 characters.
- Include the hashtag #ThankfulForYou and tag one Gate Live streamer or Gate Square creator.
- Share why you appreciate them, whether it's for trading insights, market analysis, ongoing support, personal growth, or a memorable community experience.
## Event Rewards
- Thanksgiving Lucky Draw: 50 lucky participants will be randomly selected to receive 1–5 USDT in cash rewards each. More active engagement can unlock higher rewards.
- Heartfelt Story Award: 5 outstanding Thanksgiving posts will be selected, with each author receiving one piece of exclusive Gate merchandise.
Each participant may receive only one reward under this category. Publishing multiple posts will not increase the chances of winning the lucky draw.
## Reward 3: Thanksgiving Streamer Appreciation | Top 10 Streamers, 66 Gifts for Fans
Celebrate your community and give back to the fans who support you. During the event, Gate Live streamers can participate in the Thanksgiving Streamer Rankings by hosting engaging livestreams, delivering quality content, and interacting with their audiences.
Streamers will be ranked based on their overall livestream performance. Each of the Top 10 streamers will receive one exclusive Gate merchandise gift, along with dedicated fan reward support. A total of 66 gifts will be distributed to fans through lucky draws hosted by the winning streamers.
## Participation Requirements:
- Complete at least 4 valid livestream sessions during the event, each lasting no less than 30 minutes.
- Livestream titles must include a Thanksgiving-related theme, such as "Thanksgiving".
- All livestream content must comply with Gate Live guidelines. Idle streaming, prerecorded content, artificial views, and other violations are strictly prohibited.
Overall Scoring Criteria: Streamers will be evaluated based on the number of valid livestream sessions (20%), average concurrent viewers (40%), and average engaged viewers (40%) during the event.
## Top 10 Streamer Rewards
Streamer Rank | Fan Reward Packages | Reward Details
TOP 1 | 15 | 3 Merchandise Gifts + 4 Cash Rewards + 8 Position Vouchers
TOP 2–3 | 8 each | 1 Merchandise Gift + 2 Cash Rewards + 5 Position Vouchers
TOP 4–10 | 5 each | 1 Cash Reward + 4 Position Vouchers
## Fan Reward Distribution
- After the Event: Gate will announce the Top 10 streamers based on their overall scores, along with their allocated fan reward packages.
- Streamer-Hosted Lucky Draws: Winning streamers must organize fan lucky draws within the designated period to distribute their allocated rewards.
- Official Reward Distribution: Streamers must collect and submit the winning fans' UIDs. Gate will verify the information and distribute the rewards accordingly.
## Terms and Conditions
- All participants must click "Join Now" to register and complete identity verification (KYC) before the event ends to be eligible for rewards.
- There is no daily limit on Thanksgiving livestream comments. However, one-click comments, repetitive spam, meaningless comments, bot-generated comments, and other abnormal activities will not be counted as valid participation.
- All Gate Square submissions must be original and comply with Gate Square community guidelines. Plagiarism, copied content, artificial engagement, and other fraudulent activities will be excluded.
- Each valid livestream must last at least 30 minutes and comply with Gate Live streamer guidelines. Idle streams, prerecorded content, video playback, and other invalid livestreams will not count toward event rankings.
- Top 10 winning streamers must complete their fan lucky draws and submit the winning fans' UIDs within the designated period. Failure to submit the required information on time will result in forfeiture of the corresponding rewards.
- All event participation data, valid comments, original posts, and streamer rankings are subject to Gate's backend records and final verification.
- Rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the event ends and the verification process is completed. Winner lists will be announced through the official Gate Live and Gate Square channels. The usage conditions and validity periods of Position Vouchers are subject to the details provided upon issuance.
- Physical rewards will be distributed through the Gate Merchandise Store. Winners must provide valid shipping information within the specified period. Failure to claim rewards on time will result in forfeiture. Physical rewards will be arranged for shipment within 60 days after valid shipping information is submitted. If delivery is unavailable due to shipping restrictions, equivalent platform rewards will be provided instead.
- Subaccounts and main accounts, as well as multiple accounts verified with the same identity information, will be treated as a single participant. Gate reserves the right to disqualify participants and revoke rewards in cases of bulk registrations, fraudulent engagement, artificial activity, or other violations.
- In the event of any discrepancies between language versions, the English version shall prevail. Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this event. Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted jurisdictions may not be eligible to participate in some or all event activities. Please refer to the Gate User Agreement for details.

Venue: Gate
Headline: Gate Futures Points Airdrop #173: Claim 0.078 SPCXG & 100 USDT

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
The 173rd round of the Gate Futures Points Airdrop is now live. Two exclusive reward pools are open for redemption — first-come, first-served.
Pool 1: Redeem 0.078 SPCXG with 15 Futures Points
Pool 2: Redeem 100 USDT with 20 Futures Points
Click to Join
## Reminder
To claim points airdrops, please update your App to version 8.13 or above. You can also participate directly on the Web version.
## Pool 1
Eligibility Requirement: Gate Futures Points balance ≥ 120–90 points (progressively decreasing)
Required Points: 15 Gate Futures Points
Reward: 0.078 SPCXG, first-come, first-served
Airdrop Start Time: November 27, 2026, 10:00 (UTC)
Airdrop End Time: November 27, 2026, 15:59 (UTC)
Reward Distribution: Rewards will be credited to your Spot or Unified Account within about 1 hour after successful redemption.
## Pool 2
Eligibility: Gate Futures Points balance ≥ 40 points.
Required Points: 20 Gate Futures Points
Reward: 100 USDT position vouchers, first-come, first-served
Reward Distribution: Rewards will be issued within about 1 hour after successful redemption.
## Introduction to Gate Futures Points
- Points Definition: Gate Futures Points are an activity score that reflects how active a user is in futures trading on the Gate platform, calculated based on the user's asset holdings and trading activities. The point value is the cumulative total of daily points earned over the past 15 days.
- Core Function: Points directly determine your eligibility for airdrops, TGE subscriptions, and time-limited events. The higher your points, the more events and benefits you can access.
- Balance Calculation: A daily snapshot is taken of the USDT and BTC balances in your Futures Account (calculated in USD value). If your account is in Unified Account mode (Single-Currency Margin, Cross-Currency Margin, or Portfolio Margin), the snapshot will use the USDT and BTC balances in your Spot Account under the Unified Account to calculate asset value. Fixed points are awarded based on the corresponding tier.
## Notes
- All participants must complete identity verification before claiming rewards.
- The futures trading volume excludes copy trading and bot trading.
- Futures Points currently do not support USD1 trading, and the related trading volume will not be counted.
- The token rewards from the Futures Points Airdrop are distributed by the platform solely for reward purposes. The tokens themselves are independent of the platform. The relevant project may involve certain risks and price fluctuations; participants should exercise caution and fully understand the risks before taking part.
- Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
- In case of any discrepancies between the translated version and the English version, the English version shall prevail.
- Gate reserves the sole and exclusive right to interpret this event and may modify the terms or cancel the event at its discretion without prior notice.
- Users from the United Kingdom and other restricted regions have no access to all or parts of the services (including participating in this activity, game, or competition). For more information about restricted regions, please refer to the User Agreement. Please note that we do not intend to solicit or conduct marketing towards users in these areas.
